description: Fetch BCA Academy material: 38 lessons across 8 courses covering crypto fundamentals, DeFi, trading, regulation and onchain security. Takes exactly one of slug or topic. A course slug returns the course and its lesson index; a lesson slug returns that lesson with its full text (body_md); an unknown slug returns the closest lesson as partial. A topic returns the courses tagged with it, or else the top matching lessons with their text. Applies to requests to explain a crypto concept, such as 'explain liquidity pools' or 'what is DeFi'. Works without an API key.

slug.description: Academy course slug (e.g. 'defi-fundamentals', 'understanding-bitcoin') or lesson slug (e.g. 'decentralized-exchanges').

topic.description: Topic keyword that resolves to matching academy material (e.g. 'defi', 'bitcoin').

name: get_explainer
